# S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs (Siva Sai Aqua), Bhimavaram

Aqua feed, medicines, minerals, probiotics and aerators for shrimp and fish
farmers, with poultry and veterinary medicines and feeds too. Beside Sri
Venkateswara Swamy Temple, opposite Siva Ranjini Hospital, JP Road (Bazar),
Bhimavaram, West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh 534202, India. Established
1994. Same counter, same road, 32 years. Open
8 AM to 9 PM, every day including Sunday. Phone +91 98484 99051, WhatsApp
+91 93812 04865.

## What the shop is

S.S Aqua Feeds & Needs is a small aqua trading shop on JP Road in Bhimavaram,
at the heart of the West Godavari aqua belt. Farmers call the same shelf by
the second name Siva Sai Aqua, which the shop also trades under. For 32 years
it has supplied shrimp and fish farmers within about an hour's ride of
Bhimavaram with feed, pond medicines, minerals, probiotics, aerators and
spare parts, alongside poultry and veterinary medicines and feeds. The counter
is run by Kalapu Seshagiri Rao (Seshu).

The approach at the counter is plain and practical: no prices printed here
because feed and chemical prices move with the market through a season, so
they are quoted fresh at the counter. No invented claims. If a fact has not
been confirmed by the shop, the site and this document say so rather than
guess.

## What the shop carries

Feed, pond medicines, minerals and water conditioners, probiotics and pond
culture, aerators and spares. Feed is the biggest line in every crop's
budget, so it is the shelf the shop takes most seriously. Exact brands in
stock are listed on the home page under "Brands we carry".

## Practical questions (/faq)

- How long has the shop been open? Since 1994, on the same road, in the same
  trade. That is 32 years, and the address has never moved.
- Can prices be given over the phone? Feed and chemical prices move with the
  market through the season; the counter quotes them fresh.
- Does the shop deliver? Delivery and the service area are being confirmed.

## Water parameters (/water-quality)

The shop publishes 18 water parameters with the optimum range for shrimp and
for fish, transcribed from the lab report supplied to the shop: pH, salinity,
carbon dioxide, bicarbonate, total alkalinity, total hardness, alkaline
hardness, magnesium, calcium, potassium, total ammonia, unionized ammonia,
nitrite, iron, hydrogen sulphide, dissolved oxygen, chlorine and temperature.
Values are a reference, not safe
operating targets: keep unionized ammonia and hydrogen sulphide as close to
zero as possible, and confirm species-specific targets with an aquaculture
professional before treating. The same table appears on the home page.

## The brands

The home page carries a "Brands we carry" section with all 116 brand names
rendered as plain HTML text, searchable. The same data is published as JSON
at /data/brands.json ({ count, asOf, brands: [{ name, slug, inStock }] }) and
as a PDF at /downloads/ss-aqua-brands-we-carry.pdf. The in-stock flag is a
snapshot dated 2026-10-18, not live availability: stock changes daily, so
call or visit the shop to confirm. Stock quantities are deliberately not
published, and no dealer or official-distributor status is claimed.

## Languages

Every page exists in English and in Telugu. The Telugu mirror lives under
/te/ (for example https://www.ssaquagroup.com/te/story).
